business_summary: Orient Overseas (International) Limited (HKEX: 316) is the Hong Kong-listed parent of container liner OOCL. FY2025 vendor-normalized fundamentals (data/market/0316-HK.json) show revenue of 9722494000.0, an operating margin of 11.9% and a net-cash balance sheet (net debt/EBITDA -2.30x). OOCL's own H1 2026 interim results report record liftings and liner revenue on the Gulf-diversion-tightened market, the role this link measures.

exposure_summary.narrative: ORIENT-OVERSEAS-INTERNATIONAL has 1 placement on hormuz-maritime (container-liner-diversion, position 11, CROWDED, money_corner False), backed by the issuer's own H1 2026 interim results showing liftings up 5.2% and liner revenue up 5.5% year on year. 6 of 12 canonical fields carry a sourced number; the other 6 are NULL on two real gaps: a USD-statements/HKD-price currency mismatch blocks market_cap and price_to_sales (and the reverse-DCF solve that depends on enterprise_value), and a stale long_term_debt_fy concept (1096 days behind the freshest input) blocks both quality scores.

latest_fy.basis: Revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements vendor-normalized fundamentals series in data/market/0316-HK.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (9722494000.0 / 19820188000.0) ** (1/3) - 1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31. OOIL's 2022 base was an exceptional pandemic-era freight-rate peak, so the negative CAGR reflects normalization off that spike more than a structural decline.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 1160390000.0 divided by revenue 9722494000.0, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 1990771000.0 divided by net income 1513483000.0, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow -22628000.0 (operating cash flow 1990771000.0 less capex 2013399000.0, both period ended 2025-12-31) divided by revenue 9722494000.0. Essentially break-even: OOCL's 2025 capital spending consumed almost exactly what operations generated.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -4963734000.0 (total debt 1279448000.0 less cash 6243182000.0, period ended 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 2154521000.0 (operating income 1160390000.0 plus depreciation 994131000.0, same period), from the yfinance-statements series. A net-cash liner balance sheet.

piotroski.basis: piotroski cannot be scored for ORIENT-OVERSEAS-INTERNATIONAL: data/market/0316-HK.json quality.piotroski.state is PENDING_DATA. Only 1 common fiscal period is available across the 9 inputs (the Piotroski change legs need at least 2), and long_term_debt_fy ends 2022-12-31, 1096 days behind the freshest input (2025-12-31), a stale concept the fetcher flags as likely dead.

Only 1 common fiscal period is available across the 12 inputs, and every Beneish index is a year-over-year ratio that needs at least 2; long_term_debt_fy is 1096 days stale for the same reason as the Piotroski gap.

market_cap.basis: market capitalization cannot be computed for ORIENT-OVERSEAS-INTERNATIONAL: data/market/0316-HK.json quality.currency_note states statements are reported in USD while the 316.HK listing trades in HKD, and no FX source is on disk, so the fetcher deliberately returns market_cap and enterprise_value as NULL rather than mixing currencies.

price_to_sales.basis: price to sales cannot be computed for ORIENT-OVERSEAS-INTERNATIONAL without a market capitalization; see valuation.market_cap basis (USD statements against an HKD-quoted price, no FX source on disk).

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: implied_fcf_cagr not solved for ORIENT-OVERSEAS-INTERNATIONAL: data/market/0316-HK.json quality.reverse_dcf.state is PENDING_DATA, missing enterprise_value (which itself depends on the currency-blocked market_cap).
